lines.trans: What are you doing there?
I am preparing extra rice.
And for the main course?
We will serve plenty of wine.
Igor is arriving with a surprise guest.
Is it not his wife Béatrice?
No, it is his mistress Claire.
We must stay calm and polite.
Where is the respect in that?
We cannot sit in judgment of adultery.
Our story was totally different!
We suffered as well.
We were romantic and sincere.
Then let us smile to save the evening.

examples.text: Nous ne pouvons pas juger l'adultère.
Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?
je viens d'arriver = I've just arrived

examples.text: Tu déjeunes aussi avec Dany Boon.
examples.trans: You're also having lunch with Dany Boon.

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

examples.trans: You know a lot of people.

meanings.en: beaucoup de = a lot of, many

meanings.note: une rue calme = a quiet street
before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

meanings.note: preposition: en vacances, en huit ans
pronoun before the verb: j'en ai assez, je n'en peux plus
pour faire quoi? = to do what?
faire du vélo = to ride a bike, to cycle

falloir.governs: il faut + infinitive, or il faut que + subjunctive

meanings.note: only with the impersonal 'il': il faut
il me faut un stylo = I need a pen
raconter une histoire = to tell a story
masculine or feminine noun (un invité / une invitée)

examples.text: Personne ne te juge ce soir.
Il juge ce projet très prometteur.
examples.trans: He considers this project very promising.

meanings.note: before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

examples.text: Valentin? Qu'est-ce que tu fais là-dedans?
examples.trans: Valentin? What are you doing in there?

meanings.note: for a dog: voilà ta maîtresse
ne ... pas: not; ne ... plus: not anymore; ne ... jamais: never
tag at the end of a question
everyday speech, with a he/she verb form

meanings.en: pas du tout: not at all

meanings.note: être à plat = to be worn out, flat
pronounced plys when it means 'more' at the end

examples.text: Je suis là pour voir Mathias.

examples.trans: I can't take it any more.

meanings.note: je peux t'appeler? = may I call you?
je n'en peux plus = I can't take any more
le rôle principal = the lead role

examples.text: Dis-lui que je ne peux pas venir.
J'ai beaucoup de respect pour elle.
examples.trans: I have a lot of respect for her.

examples.text: Ne restez pas là à ne rien faire!
examples.trans: Don't just stay there doing nothing!

meanings.en: rester là à + infinitive = to stay there doing

examples.text: Les Français sont de vrais romantiques.

meanings.note: un/une romantique; also adjective: un film romantique

examples.text: À quoi ça sert de payer une assistante?
examples.trans: What's the point of paying an assistant?

meanings.en: servir à = to be useful for, to be the point of
meanings.note: à quoi ça sert? = what's the point?
bonne soirée = have a nice evening
agrees with the thing owned, not the owner

examples.trans: You seem to be suffering a lot.

examples.text: Il souffre du dos depuis des jours.
examples.trans: He has been suffering from back pain for days.

examples.text: J'aime le regard et le sourire.
examples.trans: I like the look and the smile.

examples.text: Je voulais te faire la surprise.

meanings.note: faire la surprise à = to surprise someone
singular and informal: friends, family, children, colleagues of the same age

examples.text: Un verre de vin, s'il vous plaît.
